classification.conformanceProfile: Aseprite native deterministic horizontal sprite-sheet export

nonClaims: Game meaning of frame tags, actor identities, roles or animation states
caller-owned JSON metadata that is not emitted by Aseprite itself
artistic quality or gameplay suitability of the sprite
all Aseprite export modes, packed sheets, split layers, slices, tilemaps or palette conversions
cross-version reproducibility outside the exact managed Aseprite capability binding
rights or licensing validity of source or derivative content
notes: Mapped from standards-first shadow profile; remains non-production until profile-v2 graduation.

formatPolicy.callerMetadataBoundary: domain-owned metadata may consume Aseprite frames/tags but is not interpreted by this profile
formatPolicy.derivativeIdentity: generated PNG SHA-256 and native metadata SHA-256 must equal the exact object contract
formatPolicy.derivedImageValidation: generated PNG must separately pass still-image-png-srgb-r1
formatPolicy.determinism: two clean native exports with identical basenames must produce byte-identical PNG and native JSON metadata

contractSchema.claim: Aseprite export contract validates under design-2d-aseprite-sheet-contract-v1

derivativeIdentity.claim: generated PNG and native metadata exact SHA-256 values equal the object contract

derivedStillImageProfile.claim: the generated PNG independently passes still-image-png-srgb-r1

nativeDeterministicExport.claim: two clean Aseprite batch exports produce byte-identical horizontal-sheet PNG and native JSON metadata

nativeMetadataFacts.claim: Aseprite native metadata exposes the contracted sheet dimensions and frame count
